snippet.title: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
36 years before the events of Tavern Talk, the Wayfarer's Inn's future innkeeper meets their very own party for the first time, as it slowly comes together under the guidance of the Tavernkeeper of the Drowsy Dragon: You. 

Support our new Kickstarter campaign:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gentletroll/tavern-talk-stories-dreamwalker-a-cozy-visual-novel?ref=3h1gw4

Wishlist Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker now on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3500880/480?utm_source=YT

Get Tavern Talk now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076140/Tavern_Talk/

Get Tavern Talk now on Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/de-de/Spiele/Nintendo-Switch-Download-Software/Tavern-Talk-2592564.html?srsltid=AfmBOoqUqeMF8WvDQWQOy4jEAYbzMkLV1TcF3rvpgNdY77LCbPgCoyc_

Animation: Soybloq - Animation Studio (http://soybloq.com/)
Voice Over: Amelia Tyler (http://ameliatyler.com/)
Director: Selima Heister
Editing: Tommaso Crogliano
Music: Filippo Beck Peccoz 
SFX: Philipp Sellier
